hero.subtitle: Authentic Egyptian & Syrian flavors, crafted with fire and passion by women who cook from heritage. Delivered warm across Cairo.

about.aboutDesc: Dawar Kitchen is a social enterprise in Ezbet Khairallah, Cairo, where Syrian and Egyptian women craft authentic dishes rooted in heritage. Every meal supports fair employment, vocational training, and cross-cultural exchange through food.
about.recipesDesc: Time-honored Syrian and Egyptian recipes passed down through generations.
about.ingredientsDesc: Locally sourced produce, chosen daily for quality and freshness.
about.flavorsDesc: Spices and techniques that bring every dish to life with authentic taste.
about.fairWorkDesc: Empowering women through dignified work, training, and participatory decision-making.
about.supportMessage: Every order you place directly supports fair employment and vocational training for women in our community.

chefs.heading: Meet Our Chefs
chefs.description: Talented women from Syria and Egypt, bringing their heritage, skills, and passion to every dish.
